name: Custom Thank You Page for WooCommerce
author: alexvtn

sections.description:
Custom Thank You Page for WooCommerce allows you to customize the final thank-you page displayed after a WooCommerce order.

You can create the content directly from the plugin settings or use a dedicated template designed with the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg) or Elementor.

Select an existing template or create a new draft with a single click. Your current settings will be saved automatically, and you will be redirected to the editor to customize the new template.

When building a CTYP Template, you can use the dedicated Gutenberg block or Elementor widget to display the native WooCommerce order details inside your custom layout.

You can display custom content when a customer purchases a specific product or any product from your WooCommerce catalog.

For example, you can add a coupon, a custom message, additional instructions, promotional content, or the standard WooCommerce order summary to the final thank-you page.

The plugin is also compatible with popular solutions used to insert tracking codes and snippets on the WooCommerce order confirmation page.

Plugin overview

Premium features.

Dynamic user data
Dynamic user data allows you to display specific WooCommerce order values on your thank-you page, such as the order ID, as well as a list of purchased products with their price, quantity and, optionally, featured image.

Dynamic user data generator
Use the dynamic user data generator to insert a supported WooCommerce order value into the final thank-you page.

Dynamic user data for Gutenberg and Elementor
The PRO version includes a dedicated Gutenberg block and Elementor widget for inserting supported dynamic WooCommerce order values directly into your thank-you page templates.

13 additional block patterns
The PRO version includes 13 additional ready-made Gutenberg patterns that you can insert and customize to quickly create your thank-you pages.

Shortcodes support
You can include each available shortcode for WordPress shortcode.

Product selection
Set up the final thank you page for all products inside one or more product categories.

Device selection
Select one or more devices where you can load the custom content on thank you page.

Gateway ID
If needed, you can display a thank you page when an user complete the order using a specific payment gateway, like PayPal or a bank transfer.

Amount of order
If needed, you can display a thank you page when the amount of an order is higher than a specific value.

Backup section
You can import or export all your custom thank you pages by a single click.

1 click upgrades
Start automatically the plugin upgrades with simple one-click.

You can get the premium version, from the following link:
https://www.themeinprogress.com/custom-thank-you-page-for-woocommerce

Installation

Once you have installed the plugin, you just need to activate the plugin in order to enable it.

Configuration

Custom Thank You Page will add a new admin page, where you can manage all custom thank you pages.

Translators

Available Languages

  • English (Default)
  • Italiano
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/custom-thank-you-page’ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Custom Thank You Page’ page to configure the plugin.
